summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan covering:
- Expanding platform support to include all major systems (Dreamcast, Saturn, PSP, PS3, Wii, 3DS, Switch, Arcade/MAME/Neo-Geo, Sega CD, Game Boy, TG-16, etc.)
- Automatic BIOS pulling on game launch/download from RomM and fixing RomM /api/firmware response handling
- Adding a one-click manual BIOS sync button in the BIOS Manager modal
- Removing the redundant Hide JP chip in the search filter bar
